# Afsnit 345: Trumps nederlag, Novo stiger på regnskab

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-11-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish episode (Investeringspodcasten with Hansen and Larsen) built around company reports. The hosts celebrate Genmab's three strong cancer data readouts and see Novo Nordisk's better-than-feared Q3 report and cheap valuation as a re-rating opportunity. They call Jyske Bank and Danske Bank fairly priced, close to dead money, and warn that US AI neocloud stocks are fragile because of momentum trading and rising funding costs. They also discuss the US midterm elections (Democrats sweeping), Coloplast lowering its long-term targets, and Pandora's strong report helped by platinum plating.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Report much better than feared and guidance raised. Hosts call the valuation 'rock bottom' and the 4-5% rise 'feeble', expecting a re-rating. Wegovy pill gaining share, FCF 83bn DKK.

#### Reasoning

Hosts' own view. Guidance moved from -5 to -13% at the start of the year to around 0%, but the share price did not follow the upgrades. Pill uptake and high-dose Wegovy are beating analyst expectations, giving 53% GLP-1 share. Strong free cash flow cuts net debt and allows buybacks or acquisitions. The dollar's effect should show in 2027 once hedges roll off. Host Helge holds pharma shares and is not worried about US drug-price politics.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US pricing pressure intensifies sharply
- if the oral pill rollout stalls or semaglutide capacity runs short
- if Eli Lilly takes GLP-1 market share back

> *"Prisfadsættelsen er rock bottom, og nu må der vel være en situation, hvor der er nogen, der begynder at kigge med nogle lidt andre øjne på det."*

---

### 🟡 GMAB — Genmab | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host Helge has held the stock for over 25 years. Three strong cancer datasets could offset the DARZALEX loss after 2030, but after the doubling a technical pullback or overbought phase is possible.

#### Reasoning

Host's own view. Fundamentally, combined revenue from the three new indications may make up for the DARZALEX royalty loss in 2030, lifting the long-standing 'curse' on the stock. CEO Jan van de Winkel's pipeline judgement is praised. In the short term the stock doubled quickly and left a technical gap, so a pullback is possible. That supports a long-term hold rather than adding now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if follow-up data for the three drugs disappoint
- if the shift to a broad commercial pharma company fails
- if the stock fills the gap with a deep pullback on weaker fundamentals

> *"men fundamentalt, hvis man lægger indtægterne sammen i de her tre indikationer, jamen så kan det opveje det, som man mister på DAS og LEX i 2030"*

---

### 🟠 PNDORA — Pandora | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 8-9% on a strong report. Platinum plating is a success and rolling out widely. Hosts say the silver price and US consumer demand are the key factors to follow.

#### Reasoning

Hosts say Pandora delivered well against tougher comparisons. Platinum plating gives it a new tool and reduces its dependence on silver. They expect the silver price to keep easing as industry uses less silver. They name no explicit buy, so this is positive monitoring.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US consumer spending weakens sharply
- if the silver price spikes again
- if the platinum rollout disappoints

> *"Så har de lidt mere i værktøjskassen fremadrettet, og så må vi jo se, hvordan det går med sølvprisen."*

---

### 🟡 COLO-B — Coloplast | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Long-term targets cut to 5-6% growth and about 20% ROIC (a reset). Shares closed up about 3% but earnings estimates must be lowered. Hosts hope for better times without conviction.

#### Reasoning

The new CEO has reset expectations after five years in which the share price halved. The market took it as a full reset, but in the near term consensus earnings need to come down. Hosts are neutral to cautious and only 'hope better times are coming'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth falls short even of the lowered 5-6% target
- if reimbursement rules worsen further

> *"Vi må håbe, at der er bedre tider på vej, men på kort sigt, der sker der det, at indtjeningsforeningerne skal justeres lidt ned"*

---

### 🟡 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Trades at about 1.65x book, matching 15-17% long-term ROE, so fairly valued. Expected return roughly equals ROE; a recession would mean negative returns. Bank stocks called 'dead money'.

#### Reasoning

The host's valuation framework says Nordic bank P/B tracks expected ROE one-to-one. Danske is priced in line with that, so there is no upside beyond the ROE itself. The upgrade was fully in line with consensus. The host does not expect a downturn but notes the downside risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if an economic downturn brings loan losses

> *"Danske Bank handler til ca. 165% af bogført egenkapital, der svarer til, at de langsigtet kan præstere 15-17%."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Trades at about 1.3x book, matching expected 11-13% ROE over a cycle, so fairly priced. Possible dead money, and negative returns in a recession.

#### Reasoning

Same P/B-to-ROE framework as for Danske Bank: the expected return equals ROE with no re-rating upside, and the downside comes from loan losses in a downturn.

#### Sell Triggers

- if an economic downturn brings loan losses

> *"Jyske Bank handles til omkring 1,3 gange bogført egenkapital."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Down sharply on worries over rising debt financing costs. Hosts say the stock is purely momentum-driven with no valuation anchor and warn against treating it as a risk-free return.

#### Reasoning

Hosts stress that neoclouds depend on debt, corporate bonds and new share issues, all getting more expensive. The price swings 3-5x more than earnings. They call this a reminder rather than a warning, so the negative view is cautious and not an explicit sell.

#### Sell Triggers

- if funding costs ease and the compute buildout is financed cheaply

> *"det her, det er utrolig momentumdrevet"*

---
